categories.name: Physical presence
categories.blurb: How you hold yourself, before anyone has heard you speak.
categories.note: This is the fastest category to move. Posture and gaze are habits, and habits answer to reps.

categories.name: Conversation
categories.blurb: What happens once you are talking.
categories.note: Almost everything here is a pattern you learned to stay safe. It worked. It is also why conversations stall.

categories.name: Presentation
categories.blurb: Grooming, clothes, and the signal they send before you arrive.
categories.note: The cheapest points in the whole app are here. Fit and upkeep are almost entirely effort, not money or genetics.

categories.name: Mindset
categories.blurb: What runs in your head before, during and after.
categories.note: The slowest category, and the one the others feed. Expect this to shift last, from evidence rather than from arguing with yourself.

debuffs.label: I stand and sit hunched over
debuffs.detail: Shoulders forward, chest closed, chin down.

debuffs.label: I look away when someone looks at me
debuffs.detail: Eye contact never starts, or I break it first every time.

debuffs.label: People ask me to repeat myself
debuffs.detail: I get through a sentence and nobody has heard the end of it.

debuffs.label: I trail off at the end of sentences
debuffs.detail: The start is fine. The last few words dissolve.

debuffs.label: My hands are always doing something
debuffs.detail: Phone, sleeve, keys, face. Never still.

debuffs.label: I stand with my arms crossed or in my pockets
debuffs.detail: Arms folded, hands hidden, angled away from the room.

debuffs.label: I walk looking at the ground
debuffs.detail: Eyes on the pavement from door to door.

debuffs.label: I make myself small in a room
debuffs.detail: Back to the wall, knees together, out of the way.

debuffs.label: I move fast and jerky when I am nervous
debuffs.detail: Quick, clipped, like I am trying to get it over with.

debuffs.label: My hands stay frozen while I talk
debuffs.detail: Everything happens from the neck up.

debuffs.label: My face does not move much
debuffs.detail: People tell me they cannot read me, or that I look annoyed.

debuffs.label: I find hellos and handshakes awkward
debuffs.detail: The first three seconds of every meeting are a mess.

debuffs.label: I bring most topics back to me
debuffs.detail: Someone tells me something and I answer with my version of it.

debuffs.label: I talk over people without meaning to
debuffs.detail: I start my sentence before theirs has finished.

debuffs.label: I say sorry when nothing is wrong
debuffs.detail: Sorry for asking, sorry for existing, sorry for the delay.

debuffs.label: I fill every pause immediately
debuffs.detail: Two seconds of quiet and I say anything to end it.

debuffs.label: I cannot say no
debuffs.detail: I agree to things I do not want and resent it later.

debuffs.label: I tell people too much, too fast
debuffs.detail: Twenty minutes in and I have handed over the worst year of my life.

debuffs.label: My voice stays on one note
debuffs.detail: Same pitch, same speed, whatever I am saying.

debuffs.label: I do not ask people anything about themselves
debuffs.detail: I answer what I am asked and the conversation dies there.

debuffs.label: I ask questions like a checklist
debuffs.detail: Where are you from, what do you do, and then nothing.

debuffs.label: I laugh at things that are not funny
debuffs.detail: It comes out to fill space and it sounds like it.

debuffs.label: My stories land flat
debuffs.detail: I get to the end and realise there was no end.

debuffs.label: I agree even when I do not
debuffs.detail: It is easier than having the other conversation.

debuffs.label: I say 'I do not mind' to everything
debuffs.detail: Where to eat, what to watch, what I think. No input.

debuffs.label: I do not know how to end a conversation
debuffs.detail: I stay too long, or leave mid-sentence.

debuffs.label: My clothes do not fit properly
debuffs.detail: Too big, too long, bought without trying on.

debuffs.label: I dress to not be noticed
debuffs.detail: Neutral, safe, nothing that says anything.

debuffs.label: I let hair and nails go too long
debuffs.detail: I deal with it when it becomes a problem, not before.

debuffs.label: I skip the basics when nobody is watching
debuffs.detail: Days at home turn into days without the routine.

debuffs.label: My clothes are worn out and I have not replaced them
debuffs.detail: Faded, bobbled, stretched. Still in rotation.

debuffs.label: I wear the same thing every day
debuffs.detail: One combination that works, on repeat.

debuffs.label: I get out of every photo
debuffs.detail: I step behind someone or offer to take it.

debuffs.label: I do not look at myself properly
debuffs.detail: A glance to check nothing is wrong, never an actual look.

debuffs.label: My shoes are the worst thing I own
debuffs.detail: Everything else is fine and then there are the shoes.

debuffs.label: I look tired all the time
debuffs.detail: Sleep, water and daylight are all somewhere near zero.

debuffs.label: A 'no' ruins my week
debuffs.detail: One refusal and I am done trying for days.

debuffs.label: I assume people are judging me
debuffs.detail: Every room is a panel and I am being scored.

debuffs.label: I need people to like me straight away
debuffs.detail: I adjust myself in real time to get approval.

debuffs.label: I replay small moments for days
debuffs.detail: One awkward sentence, rerun for a week.

debuffs.label: I decide what people think without asking
debuffs.detail: They went quiet, so I know exactly what it meant.

debuffs.label: I do not try, so I cannot lose
debuffs.detail: I talk myself out of it before anyone gets the chance to.

debuffs.label: I measure myself against everyone
debuffs.detail: Every room has a ranking and I know where I am in it.

debuffs.label: One bad interaction defines my whole day
debuffs.detail: It goes badly at 10am and the day is written off.

debuffs.label: I wait for people to approach me
debuffs.detail: I am available, visible, and never the one who starts it.

debuffs.label: I feel like I am imposing on people
debuffs.detail: Asking for anything feels like taking something.

debuffs.label: I will not start until I am ready
debuffs.detail: The bar for starting is set where the bar for finishing should be.

debuffs.label: I cannot say anything interesting about myself
debuffs.detail: Asked what I am into, I go blank.
